dct_description_sm: "Corrections and additions from Capt. Wm. E. Merrills Map of Northern Georgia in 1864."

"Corrections and additions from Capt. Wm. E. Merrills Map of Northern Georgia in 1864." Troop positions and movements are not indicated. General campaign map showing turnpike and stage roads, railroads, towns, rivers and relief by hachures. Another copy in the Fillmore map coll. no. 264. Signed in ms: Millard Fillmore, March 12, 1865.
